title: ARC and ELLIPSE DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local transaction evidence for DRW_Arc::encodeDwg and DRW_Ellipse::encodeDwg; no physical producer or output-support claim.

implementation.behavior: Both encoders stage body, string and handle destinations with alias-aware publication. A scoped rollback guard restores the original oType on failure and publishes the entity type only after all writes succeed.
profiles: Generated ARC with nonzero center, radius, extrusion, thickness, angles, common owner/reactor/extension handles and seeded caller buffers.
Generated ELLIPSE with center, major axis, extrusion, ratio, parameter bounds, common owner/reactor/extension handles and seeded caller buffers.

allocationSweep.mechanism: One-shot global allocation failure countdown in the generated object-vector test
allocationSweep.result: Each of the four entity/version profiles reached 15 allocation-failure offsets. Every failure returned false without throwing, preserved seeded body/string/handle bytes, bit counts, handle occurrences and original oType, then succeeded on same-object retry with output equal to clean encoding.
allocationSweep.aliasControl: For each profile, failure at the first reached allocation preserved the all-streams-aliased destination and original oType; same-object retry matched the clean aliased encoding.

validation.result: PASS: ARC/ELLIPSE selector; focused CTest passed (1/1); git diff --check passed.

limitations: Generated vectors establish local failure/retry behavior only; they do not qualify ARC or ELLIPSE wire semantics or physical producer interoperability.
No native consumer rendering, complete-document output, or broad DWG support claim follows.
